rows.en:
This is strange, Cap!

Officer Anne and Annie should have been at the Aviation Day festival grounds with Hayata and the others.

Mm…

Muramatsu to Hayata… Muramatsu to Hayata! Hayata, respond! Officer Fuji, respond!

It's no good, no response…
Cap…
Captain Muramatsu! Leave this to us!
Captain Kiriyama! But…
No, Officer Anne is a member of the Ultra Garrison! We'll…

Cap… Let's leave it to the Ultra Garrison!

We have to go rescue Hayata and the others, and the "Otori"…

Mm…

Understood, Captain Kiriyama! Then I'll leave it to you!
Um… whatever you do, please don't attack those two, okay?
Alien Zarab!?
Wasn't Alien Zarab defeated by Ultraman?
Damn… Don't let it near Anne and Annie!
All right, commence attack!
Kyah…
Kyaaaah…

But, Dr. Iwamoto…

besides this Phoenix, I mean… there's no other craft that can go rescue the "Otori," is there?

It's true, my Phoenix is a space observation rocket equipped with a hydrogenate rocket engine!

I'm confident it could reach Venus, never mind rescuing the "Otori"!

But, Arashi… if what happened to the "Otori" was caused by Alien Baltan…

the unarmed Phoenix would have no way to fight…
Huh…
But we have a duty to rescue the "Otori"! Isn't there something we can do?

Hmm, it'll be quite a gamble, but…

The VTOL!

We'll build a space-going VTOL fitted with the Phoenix's rocket engine!
What!?

I'm the one who designed the VTOL! When it comes to the VTOL's performance, no one is more confident than I am…

Muramatsu… will you put your trust in me?
I'll trust you!
A space VTOL… the Science Patrol, sortieing into space. Now this is getting amazing!
Smooth, smooth… As expected of Dr. Iwamoto, eh, Arashi?
Ide… We didn't come here on a space trip!

I know, I know…

But you see, this hydrogenate rocket engine applies cutting-edge technology. It's really inspired me…
Hey… never mind that, look over there!
That's… the wreckage of the flying ship that exploded?
Yeah… and there are fighters that were doing the display flight too!
So everything that got sucked up has been gathered here?
Yeah, it's awful… Will it all just vanish forever as space debris like this?

…!?

Arashi, look at that!
Ah…!?
Contact HQ!
VTOL to HQ, VTOL to HQ!
HQ here…
Cap, this is bad! We've found the Science Patrol Car!
What!? And Hayata and the others?
No sign of them!

Why is it out in space? Was it pulled there by that reverse gravity?

First rescue Dr. Mori from the "Otori," then check whether Hayata and the others are drifting near the car!

Damn… It's a full-scale Alien Baltan assault!

Muramatsu to Arashi… Muramatsu to Arashi!

Arashi here…

Cap, what's wrong?
Alien Baltan outwitted us! Right now, the Earth is under full-scale assault by Alien Baltan.

What!?

Cap, what should we do? Head back to Earth right away?

Ah…!?

Cap, we've found the "Otori"!
What?
Cap, once we've rescued Dr. Mori, we'll head back to Earth at full speed!
All right, hurry!

Roger!

Prepare to launch the rescue capsule!
Security Squad, arriving! We'll provide support.

Annie…

What is going on?
What Mr. Tachibana said… it seems it was true.
Unbelievable… What on earth happened?

[HERO2], be careful! Better not get close to Anne and Annie… You'll get stepped on!

Especially near Annie… It's a sight that's bad for your eyes, [HERO2].
…!? Bad for my eyes? What's that supposed to mean?
…I-I wouldn't know{drop}

All units, prepare to attack! We're supporting the Ultra Garrison!

But… don't lay a hand on Officer Anne or Annie! Understood?
Roger!
Daisaku… Come now, cheer up and stand.
Who… who called me?
It was me, Daisaku…
Ah…!?
There's no need to be surprised… I am Alien Mefilas, come all the way from the far reaches of space.
Alien Mefilas?

Now then, Daisaku…

As I watched this Earth from my planet, I came to want the Earth and you, Daisaku, more than anything.

But I hate violence. Even on my planet, a gentleman is polite… Taking the Earth by force is against my rules!

So I would like to get permission from you, Daisaku, an Earthling… You are a splendid Earthling, Daisaku.

What do you say? Just one phrase to me… Won't you say, "I'll give the Earth to you"?
No! Absolutely not!
I thought so… No one wants to abandon their home. But look at this.

The universe is infinitely vast, and wonderful too.

There are many heavenly planets where there's no war like on Earth, no traffic accidents, where you can live for hundreds, even thousands of years.

What do you say, Daisaku? Wouldn't you like to toss the Earth aside and become a person of such a planet?
No!

What an unreasonable child! Why? Why can't you say, "I'll give the Earth to you"?

I like you! I'm offering you eternal life on my planet!

No matter how long I could live by myself, no matter how rich a life I could have, it wouldn't make me happy at all!

I'm a person of Earth! I'm going to protect the Earth with Giant Robo!
Silence!
Waah…
Hahaha…
Hahaha!
…!? Ultraman, what's so funny?

Mefilas, you were way off the mark! There's no human who would sell out the Earth!

Even a child would want to make the Earth a better place, never abandon it!

And besides, Daisaku is fighting alongside Giant Robo to protect the Earth's peace!
Nngh… Silence, Ultraman! Are you an alien or a human?
Both… I was born to fight those like you who break the laws of the universe!

uncertain: U11304/U11306: speaker shown as "Kiriyama" (speaker_jp キリヤマ).
U11310-U11312: Alien Zarab appears (likely the disguise behind the giant Anne/Annie).
U11320-U11336: ビートル rendered "VTOL" (glossary Jet VTOL).
U11355: 目の毒 rendered "bad for your eyes" (a too-tempting sight).
U11357: {drop} icon kept at the end as in the Japanese.
U11376-U11380: speaker Hayata, but Mefilas addresses him as Ultraman; kept as written.
U11380: 西方 read as 両方 "Both".

new_names.why: Dr. Iwamoto's rocket, not in glossary
